analysis_scope.composition: Explicit cohort pilot: one composition per variant; equal group counts need not mean equal rows, duration or information.
analysis_scope.modality: The movement candidate learns aligned numerical actions; the RGB predictor does not control the arm.
analysis_scope.novelty: Only exact source object/target layout exclusion is checked relative to supplied hash-bound native declarations; no out-of-distribution or human-transfer claim.
analysis_scope.scene_independence: The same distinct benchmark scenes are reused for every candidate; condition-by-scene runs are not independent scenes.
analysis_scope.stratification: Nominal and actuator-stress outcomes are reported separately. Combined counts and clocks are execution totals, not a pooled performance estimate.

comparisons.training_pipeline_timing_scope: Intake, frame decoding and learning; final receipt hashes, run JSON, ZIP creation and integrity verification excluded.

development_diagnosis.hypothesis: A nearby unused training layout may improve the learned movement head; distance is a selection heuristic, not evidence of cause.

limitations: One selected composition per condition cannot establish a general learning curve.
Historical test recordings already inspected remain regression diagnostics, not fresh confirmation.
A fresh seed excludes declared layouts but does not independently attest prior non-exposure.
Privileged simulator state and authored phase, gripper and recovery logic remain.
No human-video action recovery, new human footage, physical skill, automatic promotion or reward.

recipe.control: Same recorded arm targets with jaws open.
recipe.evaluation: Same fresh nominal/stress scenes for every candidate; all source and known development layouts excluded.
recipe.freeze: Membership and selection before fitting; every candidate before evaluation.
recipe.selection: Existing fixed development sources choose ridge regularization.

selection.generic_rule: Seeded SHA256 order among the remaining unused TRAIN groups, excluding the targeted choice.
selection.reason: Whole-source group counts are matched; actual action rows and video duration are reported separately.
selection.rule: Minimum object+target XYZ Euclidean distance among unused TRAIN groups; ties by group ID.

limitations: Training group counts and numerical action sample counts are different evidence units.
The same frozen source dev/test episodes and benchmark scenes are shared across candidates; they are not independent repeated studies.
Scene exclusion is relative to hash-bound supplier declarations when supplied; otherwise source-scene disjointness is unestablished.
Actuator-stress failures can be shared physical/controller limits, not a demonstrated need for more labels.
Privileged native simulator state and authored phases, gripper/contact logic and recovery remain in use.
No raw human-video action bridge, minimum demonstration count, physical robot skill or guaranteed performance is established.
Aggregate results never authorize an untested scene; installed execution still needs its exact current-runtime qualification.
timing_scope: Benchmark function wall time includes arm dependency imports, source validation, scene planning, input copies, frozen plans, fits, installation, native evaluations and artifact output before the final report. Process startup, top-level module imports and final report writing are excluded. Pipeline and native episode clocks retain their own narrower scopes.
